result.summary: Analysis identified two visual issues concerning text layout and color contrast.

issues.description: Text elements for delivery time and cost overlap under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing.
issues.suggestion: Correct the vertical spacing or layout constraints to prevent text stacking.

issues.description: Inactive filter chips like 'Pizza' and 'Sushi' have low text contrast against their background.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font weight or darken the text color to meet accessibility standards.
